","comms":"data:image/webp;base64,","observation":"data:image/webp;base64,"}};
  const bitmaps={moon:new Map(),orbit:new Map(),mars:new Map()};
  const images={moon:new Map(),orbit:new Map(),mars:new Map()};
  const loading={moon:new Map(),orbit:new Map(),mars:new Map()};
  const stats={decodedCount:0,cacheHits:0,worldsPreloaded:[],errors:[]};

  function getSourceMap(world){
    if(world==='moon')return window.__MOONSHIFT_MOON_RM||null;
    return WORLD_ASSETS[world]||null;
  }

  async function decodeRoomAsset(world,roomId){
    if(bitmaps[world]?.has(roomId))return bitmaps[world].get(roomId);
    if(loading[world]?.has(roomId))return loading[world].get(roomId);
    const srcMap=getSourceMap(world);
    const src=srcMap&&srcMap[roomId];
    if(!src)return null;

    const p=(async()=>{
      try{
        let img=images[world].get(roomId);
        if(!img){
          img=new Image();
          img.decoding='async';
          img.src=src;
          images[world].set(roomId,img);
        }
        if(img.decode){
          await img.decode();
        }else if(!img.complete){
          await new Promise((res,rej)=>{img.onload=res;img.onerror=rej;});
        }
        let tex=img;
        if(typeof createImageBitmap==='function'){
          try{tex=await createImageBitmap(img);}catch(_){tex=img;}
        }
        bitmaps[world].set(roomId,tex);
        stats.decodedCount++;
        return tex;
      }catch(err){
        stats.errors.push(world+':'+roomId+':'+(err?.message||'decode_error'));
        return null;
      }finally{
        loading[world].delete(roomId);
      }
    })();
    loading[world].set(roomId,p);
    return p;
  }

  function preloadWorld(world,priorityRoomId){
    const srcMap=getSourceMap(world);
    if(!srcMap)return;
    if(!stats.worldsPreloaded.includes(world))stats.worldsPreloaded.push(world);
    const ids=Object.keys(srcMap);
    if(priorityRoomId&&ids.includes(priorityRoomId)){
      decodeRoomAsset(world,priorityRoomId);
    }
    const rest=ids.filter(id=>id!==priorityRoomId);
    // Decode remaining rooms asynchronously in small idle batches to prevent main-thread hitching
    let idx=0;
    const step=()=>{
      if(idx<rest.length){
        decodeRoomAsset(world,rest[idx++]).finally(()=>{
          if(idx<rest.length)setTimeout(step,45);
        });
      }
    };
    setTimeout(step,0);
  }

  function releaseInactiveWorldBitmaps(activeWorld){
    for(const w of ['moon','orbit','mars']){
      if(w===activeWorld)continue;
      const map=bitmaps[w];
      if(!map||map.size===0)continue;
      for(const tex of map.values()){
        if(tex&&typeof tex.close==='function'){
          try{tex.close();}catch(_){}
        }
      }
      map.clear();
    }
  }

  function getReadyTexture(world,roomId){
    const bm=bitmaps[world]?.get(roomId);
    if(bm){stats.cacheHits++;return bm;}
    decodeRoomAsset(world,roomId);
    const img=images[world]?.get(roomId);
    if(img&&img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0)return img;
    return null;
  }

  function drawLoadingPlaceholder(ctx,room){
    const b=room.bounds;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle=room.floorColor||'#1a2835';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(140,185,205,0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(let x=b.x+48;x<b.x+b.w;x+=48){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,b.y);ctx.lineTo(x,b.y+b.h);ctx.stroke();}
    for(let y=b.y+48;y<b.y+b.h;y+=48){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(b.x,y);ctx.lineTo(b.x+b.w,y);ctx.stroke();}
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function install(){
    const map=window.StationMap;
    if(!map||!map.__moonRoomArt||!map.renderPremiumFloor||!map.renderRoomDetails||!map.renderFurniture||!map.isPassable)return false;
    if(map.__worldArtUnified)return true;

    const prevFloor=map.renderPremiumFloor.bind(map);
    const prevDetails=map.renderRoomDetails.bind(map);
    const prevFurniture=map.renderFurniture.bind(map);
    const prevPass=map.isPassable.bind(map);
    const prevApplyWorld=map.applyWorld?map.applyWorld.bind(map):null;

    map.renderPremiumFloor=function(ctx,room){
      const w=this.currentWorld||'moon';
      if(w==='moon'||w==='orbit'||w==='mars'){
        const tex=getReadyTexture(w,room.id);
        if(tex){
          const b=room.bounds;
          ctx.drawImage(tex,b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h);
          return;
        }
        if(w==='orbit'||w==='mars'){
          drawLoadingPlaceholder(ctx,room);
          return;
        }
      }
      return prevFloor(ctx,room);
    };

    map.renderRoomDetails=function(ctx,room){
      const w=this.currentWorld||'moon';
      if(w==='moon'||w==='orbit'||w==='mars')return;
      return prevDetails(ctx,room);
    };

    const unifiedFurniture=function(ctx,room){
      const w=this.currentWorld||'moon';
      if(w==='moon'||w==='orbit'||w==='mars')return;
      return prevFurniture(ctx,room);
    };
    map.renderFurniture=unifiedFurniture;

    // Keep unified furniture & room-details policy active if legacy installers re-attach
    const unifiedDetails=map.renderRoomDetails;
    const monitor=setInterval(()=>{
      if(map.renderFurniture!==unifiedFurniture)map.renderFurniture=unifiedFurniture;
      if(map.renderRoomDetails!==unifiedDetails)map.renderRoomDetails=unifiedDetails;
    },1500);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>clearInterval(monitor),{once:true});

    // Accurate room-local collision geometry (rectangles & circles) for Orbit and Mars
    const WORLD_COLLISIONS={
      orbit:{
        dock:[[18,12,165,130],[345,15,165,130],[18,305,155,140],[335,315,175,130]],
        airlock:[[22,12,150,125],[365,12,135,130],[20,145,95,100],[20,260,110,95],[20,365,115,90],[350,195,145,105],[375,345,125,105]],
        centralHab:[{cx:379,cy:267,r:72},[18,22,235,125],[475,21,125,95],[22,395,165,135],[475,395,125,110]],
        quarters:[[22,12,185,128],[225,20,165,65],[425,15,165,122],[35,165,120,100],[28,295,175,120],[430,295,165,115]],
        shelter:[[20,15,230,110],[365,15,175,110],[181,299,179,126],[367,295,194,130]],
        power:[[18,15,160,85],[415,15,180,100],[430,165,155,130],[22,355,225,120],[440,350,155,120]],
        lifeSupport:[[195,10,275,50],[500,15,145,115],[18,210,195,110],[470,215,175,110],[18,375,215,120],[445,375,200,120]],
        greenhouse:[[20,20,175,145],[20,365,170,165],[435,390,185,145]],
        comms:[[20,15,205,115],[395,15,175,110],[375,165,195,100],[25,345,190,100],[410,345,150,100]],
        observation:[[32,52,138,112],[505,65,145,105],[32,385,178,88],[470,375,175,98]]
      },
      mars:{
        dock:[[18,12,170,130],[345,15,165,130],[18,305,160,140],[335,315,175,130]],
        airlock:[[22,12,150,125],[380,12,140,130],[20,145,95,100],[20,260,110,95],[20,365,120,90],[365,195,150,105],[375,345,145,105]],
        centralHab:[{cx:377,cy:265,r:72},[18,22,235,125],[470,25,130,95],[22,395,165,135],[475,395,125,110]],
        quarters:[[22,12,185,125],[225,20,165,65],[425,15,165,122],[35,165,120,100],[28,295,175,120],[430,295,165,115]],
        shelter:[[20,15,230,110],[395,15,175,110],[205,305,195,120],[410,315,185,110]],
        power:[[18,15,160,85],[415,15,180,100],[430,170,155,130],[22,360,225,120],[440,355,155,120]],
        lifeSupport:[[195,10,275,50],[500,15,145,115],[18,205,195,110],[470,210,175,110],[18,365,215,115],[445,365,200,115]],
        greenhouse:[[20,15,135,135],[20,210,185,105],[20,415,140,120],[425,30,195,95],[425,155,195,80],[425,265,195,80],[425,425,195,105]],
        comms:[[20,15,205,115],[425,15,195,110],[405,165,215,100],[25,345,190,100],[465,345,150,100]],
        observation:[[245,205,165,125],[20,15,195,120],[430,15,195,120],[20,395,210,115],[465,395,160,115]]
      }
    };
    function hitsShape(x,y,r,shape,b){
      if(Array.isArray(shape)){
        const lx=x-b.x,ly=y-b.y;
        const cx=Math.max(shape[0],Math.min(lx,shape[0]+shape[2]));
        const cy=Math.max(shape[1],Math.min(ly,shape[1]+shape[3]));
        return (lx-cx)**2+(ly-cy)**2<r*r;
      }
      return Math.hypot(x-(b.x+shape.cx),y-(b.y+shape.cy))<(r+shape.r);
    }

    map.isPassable=function(x,y,radius=20){
      if(!prevPass(x,y,radius))return false;
      const w=this.currentWorld||'moon';
      if(w==='orbit'||w==='mars'){
        const inCorridor=(this.corridors||[]).some(c=>this.isPointInCorridor(c,x,y));
        if(inCorridor)return true;
        const room=this.getRoomAt(x,y);
        if(!room||!room.bounds)return true;
        const shapes=WORLD_COLLISIONS[w]?.[room.id];
        if(shapes&&shapes.some(s=>hitsShape(x,y,radius,s,room.bounds)))return false;
      }
      return true;
    };

    // Development-only collision-debug overlay (disabled in production by default)
    let debugEnabled=false;
    try{debugEnabled=/[?&]debugCollisions=1/.test(window.location.search||'');}catch(_){}
    window.MoonshiftCollisionDebug={
      get enabled(){return debugEnabled;},
      set enabled(v){debugEnabled=!!v;},
      toggle(){debugEnabled=!debugEnabled;return debugEnabled;}
    };
    const prevRender=map.render.bind(map);
    map.render=function(ctx,camera){
      prevRender(ctx,camera);
      if(!debugEnabled)return;
      const w=this.currentWorld||'moon';
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(-camera.x,-camera.y);
      const worldCols=WORLD_COLLISIONS[w];
      for(const room of Object.values(this.rooms||{})){
        const b=room.bounds;
        if(!b)continue;
        const shapes=worldCols?.[room.id];
        if(shapes){
          for(const s of shapes){
            ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,64,64,0.24)';
            ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,90,90,0.9)';
            ctx.lineWidth=2;
            if(Array.isArray(s)){
              ctx.fillRect(b.x+s[0],b.y+s[1],s[2],s[3]);
              ctx.strokeRect(b.x+s[0],b.y+s[1],s[2],s[3]);
            }else{
              ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x+s.cx,b.y+s.cy,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const p=window.Engine?.player;
      if(p){
        ctx.strokeStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.radius||20,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    };

    if(prevApplyWorld){
      map.applyWorld=function(world){
        prevApplyWorld(world);
        const w=world||'moon';
        releaseInactiveWorldBitmaps(w);
        preloadWorld(w,'dock');
      };
    }

    preloadWorld(map.currentWorld||'moon','dock');
    map.__worldArtUnified=true;
    window.MoonshiftWorldArt={
      version:'2.0.0',
      stats,
      bitmaps,
      preloadWorld,
      decodeRoomAsset
    };
    return true;
  }

  if(!install()){
    let n=0;const t=setInterval(()=>{if(install()||++n>120)clearInterval(t);},120);
  }
})();</script>
<script id="v32-audio-bridge">
(() => {
  'use strict';
  if (!window.MoonshiftAudioMixer) {
    window.MoonshiftAudioMixer = {
      duck(active) { window.Audio?.setVoiceDucked?.(!!active); },
      get userVolume() { return window.Audio?.musicVolume ?? 0.42; },
      get enabled() { return !(window.Audio?.muted || window.Audio?.musicMuted); },
      get ducked() { return !!window.Audio?._voiceDucked; }
    };
  } else if (typeof window.MoonshiftAudioMixer.duck !== 'function') {
    window.MoonshiftAudioMixer.duck = (active) => window.Audio?.setVoiceDucked?.(!!active);
  }
  if (!window.MoonshiftV32) {
    window.MoonshiftV32 = {
      reloadHuman() {
        if (window.Story?.isDialogueActive && window.Voice?.enabled) {
          window.Story.startCurrentDialogueVoice?.();
        }
      }
    };
  }
})();
</script>

};
async function startCall(){if(state.phase==='connecting'||state.ws?.readyState===1)return;if(!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia){setStatus('error','Microphone needs HTTPS and a supported browser.');return;}state.minimized=false;state.muted=false;setStatus('connecting');updateRole();try{
const r=await fetch('/api/live-token',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:'{}',cache:'no-store'});const info=await r.json();if(!r.ok||!info.token)throw Error(info.detail||info.error||'Connection unavailable');
state.audio=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();state.playGain=state.audio.createGain();state.playGain.gain.value=.78;state.playGain.connect(state.audio.destination);await state.audio.resume();state.stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true},video:false});state.permission=true;
const ws=new WebSocket('wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1alpha.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContentConstrained?access_token='+encodeURIComponent(info.token));state.ws=ws;
ws.onopen=()=>{const scene=ctx();send({setup:{model:'models/'+info.model,generationConfig:{responseModalities:['AUDIO']},inputAudioTranscription:{},outputAudioTranscription:{},systemInstruction:{parts:[{text:'You are an original Moonshift science guide for children 7–12. Be warm, conversational, accurate and concise. Speak in the language used by the child (Arabic or English). Speak as a knowledgeable space-science expert, NEVER as an official NASA employee. When asked about the present mission, explain current settings, target ranges and direct useful next steps. Never claim fictional telemetry is real NASA data. If the child makes a mistake, encourage experimentation with simple cause/effect language. Avoid announcing lines assigned to the human recorded crew. Current scene: '+JSON.stringify(scene)}]}}});};
ws.onmessage=async event=>{let raw;try{raw=JSON.parse(typeof event.data==='string'?event.data:await event.data.text())}catch{return;}if(raw.setupComplete){await enableMic();pauseHuman();setStatus('listening');state.timer=setTimeout(()=>stopCall({reason:'Session time limit reached'}),12*60*1000);return;}if(raw.error){setStatus('error',raw.error.message||'Unable to continue this call');return;}const m=raw.serverContent||{};if(m.interrupted){clearPlayback();setStatus(state.muted?'muted':'listening');}if(m.inputTranscription?.text)updateTranscript('You',m.inputTranscription.text);if(m.outputTranscription?.text)updateTranscript('Guide',m.outputTranscription.text);for(const p of m.modelTurn?.parts||[]){if(p.inlineData?.mimeType?.includes('audio')||p.inlineData?.data?.length>100)playPCM(p.inlineData.data);}if(m.turnComplete){commitTranscript();if(state.phase!=='closed'&&state.phase!=='error')setStatus(state.muted?'muted':'listening');}};
ws.onerror=()=>{if(state.phase!=='ended'&&state.phase!=='closed')setStatus('error','Connection lost. End and try again.');};ws.onclose=()=>{if(state.phase!=='closed'&&state.phase!=='ended')stopCall({reason:'Connection closed'});};
}catch(e){let msg=e?.name==='NotAllowedError'?'Microphone blocked. Allow it in your browser and retry.':e?.name==='NotFoundError'?'No microphone detected.':(e?.message||'Could not start voice');stopCall({reason:msg});setStatus('error',msg);}}
function toggleMute(){if(!state.stream)return;state.muted=!state.muted;for(const t of state.stream.getAudioTracks())t.enabled=!state.muted;setStatus(state.muted?'muted':'listening');}
function showTranscript(){state.showTranscript=!state.showTranscript;transcriptView.hidden=!state.showTranscript;transcriptBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(state.showTranscript));renderTranscript();}
function showType(){state.showType=!state.showType;const box=$('v32-type-area');box.hidden=!state.showType;typeBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(state.showType));if(state.showType)textArea.focus({preventScroll:true});}
function sendText(){const q=textArea.value.trim();if(!q)return;if(!state.ws||state.ws.readyState!==1){setStatus('error','Start a call to ask with AI.');return;}send({clientContent:{turns:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:'Current mission context: '+JSON.stringify(ctx())+'\nQuestion: '+q}]}],turnComplete:true}});state.transcript.you=q;renderTranscript();textArea.value='';setStatus('thinking');}
function init(){if($('#v32-voice-root'))return;
root=document.createElement('section');root.id='v32-voice-root';root.dataset.phase='closed';root.setAttribute('aria-label','Moonshift mission expert voice conversation');root.innerHTML=`<button type="button" id="v32-launch" class="v32-voice-launch" aria-label="Talk to a science expert"><span class="v32-launch-glyph">✦</span><span>Ask mission expert</span><span class="v32-voice-mic-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="2.5" width="6" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M5.5 10.5v1.5a6.5 6.5 0 0013 0v-1.5M12 18.5v3m-4 0h8"/></svg></span></button><div id="v32-card" class="v32-call-card" hidden><div class="v32-call-main"><div id="v32-orb" class="v32-voice-orb" aria-hidden="true"><span class="v32-wave"></span><span class="v32-wave"></span><span class="v32-wave"></span><span class="v32-wave"></span><span class="v32-wave"></span></div><div class="v32-call-labels"><div id="v32-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Connecting…</div><small id="v32-role">Mission Science Expert · AI guide</small></div><div class="v32-call-actions"><button type="button" class="v32-call-icon" id="v32-mute" aria-label="Mute microphone" title="Mute microphone"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="2.5" width="6" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M5.5 10.5v1.5a6.5 6.5 0 0013 0v-1.5M12 18.5v3m-4 0h8"/></svg></button><button type="button" class="v32-call-icon v32-end-call" id="v32-end" aria-label="End call" title="End call">✕</button><button type="button" class="v32-call-icon v32-minimize" id="v32-min" aria-label="Minimize voice panel" title="Minimize">⌄</button></div></div><div class="v32-subactions"><button id="v32-caption-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false">Captions</button><button id="v32-type-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false">⌨ Type instead</button><button id="v32-retry" type="button" hidden>Retry</button></div><div id="v32-transcript" class="v32-transcript" hidden aria-live="off"></div><div id="v32-type-area" hidden class="v32-type-area"><input id="v32-question" placeholder="Ask about this experiment" maxlength="350" aria-label="Type a science question"/><button id="v32-send" type="button">Send</button></div></div>`;
document.body.append(root);launcher=$('v32-launch');card=$('v32-card');orb=$('v32-orb');roleLabel=$('v32-role');statusLabel=$('v32-status');micBtn=$('v32-mute');stopBtn=$('v32-end');minBtn=$('v32-min');transcriptBtn=$('v32-caption-toggle');typeBtn=$('v32-type-toggle');transcriptView=$('v32-transcript');textArea=$('v32-question');sendBtn=$('v32-send');retryBtn=$('v32-retry');launcher.onclick=startCall;micBtn.onclick=toggleMute;stopBtn.onclick=()=>stopCall();orb.onclick=()=>{if(state.minimized){state.minimized=false;root.classList.remove('v32-minimized');minBtn.textContent='⌄'}};minBtn.onclick=()=>{state.minimized=!state.minimized;root.classList.toggle('v32-minimized',state.minimized);minBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',state.minimized?'Expand voice panel':'Minimize voice panel');minBtn.textContent=state.minimized?'⌃':'⌄'};transcriptBtn.onclick=showTranscript;typeBtn.onclick=showType;sendBtn.onclick=sendText;textArea.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();sendText();}e.stopPropagation()});retryBtn.onclick=startCall;window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>stopCall());document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&state.stream){toggleMute();}});setStatus('closed');}
window.MoonshiftLiveGuide={start:startCall,stop:()=>stopCall(),open:startCall,context:ctx,get connected(){return state.ws?.readyState===1&&state.phase!=='error'},get status(){return state.phase}};
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();

</script>
<script id="ms-discover-nav">
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const NASA_PROVENANCE = {
    task_power: 'NASA ECLSS & Solar Power Simulation (https://www.nasa.gov/reference/environmental-control-and-life-support-systems-eclss/)',
    task_scrubber: 'NASA ECLSS CO2 Amine Scrubber Model (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/eclss-technical-brief-ochmo.pdf)',
    task_water: 'NASA ISS Water Recovery ICES 2024-317 (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20240005472/downloads/ICES%202024-317%20Status%20of%20ISS%20ECLSS%20Water%20Recovery%20and%20Management.pdf)',
    task_greenhouse: 'NASA Veggie & APH Plant Lighting Model (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20210022119/downloads/Stars%20APH%20PONDS%20Talk%202021.pdf?attachment=true)',
    task_comms: 'NASA DSN & Mars Comm Delay (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf)',
    task_shelter: 'NASA CCMC DONKI Solar Event Drill (https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/tools/DONKI/)',
    task_rover: 'NASA Mars Perseverance Rover Mobility Model (https://science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/science-instruments/)',
    task_gravity: 'NASA Microgravity & Planetary Gravity Comparison (https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/glenn/what-is-microgravity/)',
    task_thermal: 'NASA Habitat Thermal & Power Trade-off Model (fictional training parameters)'
  };

  let activeFilter = 'all';
  let overlay = null;

  function getCompletedSet() {
    const set = new Set();
    const simDone = window.Sim?.completedTasks;
    if (Array.isArray(simDone)) simDone.forEach(x => set.add(x));
    else if (simDone instanceof Set) simDone.forEach(x => set.add(x));
    const storyDone = window.Story?.completedTasks;
    if (Array.isArray(storyDone)) storyDone.forEach(x => set.add(x));
    else if (storyDone instanceof Set) storyDone.forEach(x => set.add(x));
    return set;
  }

  function isTaskUnlocked(id) {
    const ch = Number(window.Story?.chapter || 1);
    const chapterGate = {
      task_power: 1, task_scrubber: 1, task_water: 2, task_greenhouse: 2,
      task_comms: 3, task_shelter: 4, task_gravity: 1, task_rover: 3, task_thermal: 2
    };
    const req = chapterGate[id] || 1;
    return { unlocked: ch >= req, reqChapter: req };
  }

  function buildItems() {
    const map = window.StationMap;
    const world = window.Story?.world || map?.currentWorld || 'moon';
    const worldTitle = window.WORLD_META?.[world]?.title || world.toUpperCase();
    const completed = getCompletedSet();
    const items = [];

    if (map?.interactables) {
      for (const [id, item] of Object.entries(map.interactables)) {
        const roomName = map.rooms?.[item.roomId]?.name || item.roomId;
        const isTask = id.startsWith('task_');
        const isDone = completed.has(id);
        const gate = isTask ? isTaskUnlocked(id) : { unlocked: true, reqChapter: 1 };
        const status = isDone ? 'done' : (gate.unlocked ? 'avail' : 'locked');
        items.push({
          id,
          title: item.name || item.shortLabel || id,
          room: `${worldTitle} · ${roomName}`,
          roomId: item.roomId,
          x: item.x,
          y: item.y,
          category: isTask ? 'nasa' : 'station',
          status,
          unlockNote: gate.unlocked ? 'Accessible now in this room' : `Unlocks in Chapter ${gate.reqChapter} (story progression)`,
          desc: item.description || 'Interactive station console.',
          nasa: NASA_PROVENANCE[id] || 'Station telemetry & narrative archive',
          actionType: 'waypoint'
        });
      }
    }

    items.push({
      id: 'live_voice_guide',
      title: 'Live Voice Mission Expert (V32)',
      room: 'Global HUD · Bottom-Right Floating Pill',
      category: 'station',
      status: 'avail',
      unlockNote: 'Always available (does not interrupt prerecorded crew audio)',
      desc: 'Real-time microphone voice conversation with the AI science guide.',
      nasa: 'Gemini Live API + Mission Context',
      actionType: 'voice'
    });

    items.push({
      id: 'audio_mixer_ctrl',
      title: 'Audio & Music Volume Mixer',
      room: 'Global HUD · Top-Right AUDIO Button',
      category: 'station',
      status: 'avail',
      unlockNote: 'Always available; persists in localStorage',
      desc: 'Independent Music, Sound FX, Crew Voices, and Master Mute sliders.',
      nasa: 'Web Audio API + HTML5 Audio',
      actionType: 'audio'
    });

    return items;
  }

  function renderCards() {
    if (!overlay) return;
    const body = overlay.querySelector('#msExploreBody');
    const items = buildItems().filter(it => {
      if (activeFilter === 'all') return true;
      if (activeFilter === 'avail') return it.status === 'avail';
      if (activeFilter === 'done') return it.status === 'done';
      if (activeFilter === 'nasa') return it.category === 'nasa';
      if (activeFilter === 'station') return it.category === 'station';
      return true;
    });

    body.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
      const badgeText = it.status === 'done' ? '✓ COMPLETED' : (it.status === 'avail' ? '● AVAILABLE' : '🔒 LOCKED');
      const btnLabel = it.actionType === 'voice' ? 'Open Live Voice' : (it.actionType === 'audio' ? 'Open Audio Mixer' : 'Set Waypoint');
      return `<article class="ms-explore-card">
        <div class="ms-explore-card-top">
          <div>
            <h3>${it.title}</h3>
            <div class="ms-explore-room">${it.room}</div>
          </div>
          <span class="ms-badge ${it.status}">${badgeText}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="ms-explore-desc">${it.desc}</p>
        <div class="ms-explore-meta"><strong>Access:</strong> ${it.unlockNote}<br><strong>Science:</strong> ${it.nasa}</div>
        <div class="ms-explore-actions">
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-btn" data-ms-action="${it.actionType}" data-ms-id="${it.id}" data-ms-room="${it.roomId || ''}">${btnLabel}</button>
        </div>
      </article>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function openModal() {
    if (!overlay) {
      overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.id = 'msExploreOverlay';
      overlay.className = 'ms-explore-overlay';
      overlay.hidden = true;
      overlay.innerHTML = `<section class="ms-explore-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Mission and Feature Navigator">
        <header class="ms-explore-head">
          <div>
            <h2>✦ MISSION & FEATURE NAVIGATOR</h2>
            <div class="ms-explore-sub">Find mini-games, NASA experiments, research stations, Live Voice, and audio settings.</div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-close" id="msExploreClose" aria-label="Close navigator">×</button>
        </header>
        <div class="ms-explore-tabs">
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-tab active" data-filter="all">All Features</button>
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-tab" data-filter="avail">Available Now</button>
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-tab" data-filter="done">Completed</button>
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-tab" data-filter="nasa">NASA Science</button>
          <button type="button" class="ms-explore-tab" data-filter="station">Stations & Audio</button>
        </div>
        <div clas
